meta.name: excalidraw
meta.description: Use when user requests diagrams, flowcharts, architecture charts, or visualizations. Also use proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components, complex data flows, or relationships that benefit from visual representation. Generates .excalidraw files and exports to PNG/SVG via Kroki API or locally using excalidraw-brute-export-cli.

copy.tagline: 把系统架构和流程画成图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要画流程图、架构图来辅助沟通
copy.tagline_en: Turn system architectures and flows into diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to draw flowcharts or architecture diagrams to aid communication

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成 Excalidraw 格式的图表文件（如流程图、架构图），并导出为 PNG 或 SVG 图片。
howto.when: 当你要求画图、流程图、架构图或可视化内容时触发；当 Claude 在解释包含 3 个以上组件的系统时也会主动使用。

say.text: 帮我画一个用户登录的流程图。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Excalidraw 文件并导出图片。

say.text: 用 Excalidraw 画一个微服务架构图。
say.note: Claude 会绘制包含多个服务的架构图。

say.text: 把这个流程可视化一下。
say.note: Claude 会主动判断是否适合用图表展示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate Excalidraw diagram files (e.g., flowcharts, architecture diagrams) based on your description and export them as PNG or SVG images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for diagrams, flowcharts, architecture charts, or visualizations; also used proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components.

say_en.text: Draw a flowchart for user login.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an Excalidraw file and export an image.

say_en.text: Create a microservice architecture diagram with Excalidraw.
say_en.note: Claude will draw a diagram with multiple services.
Claude will decide if a diagram is appropriate.
